blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Defense lead counsel lawyer Michael Poa opened his arguments on the impeachment voting threshold by quoting the Supreme Court: “When the law is clear, there is no room for interpretation; there is only room for application.” Poa urged the Senate impeachment court not to “complicate what the Constitution has made simple,” maintaining the defense’s position that the voting threshold to convict Vice President Sara Duterte should be based on the full 24-member Senate. /dp READ: WATCH: Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Sept. 23, 2026...
